description: Ask the **Etapa cycling coach** any question about cycling, training, plan adjustments, recovery, nutrition, gear, or technique. Answers are in plain English — no jargon, beginner-friendly, and grounded in established training science. Use this for open-ended questions, plan adaptations ("I missed a ride, what now?"), or when the rider wants an opinion. Powered by the Etapa API.

context.description: Optional background about the rider (fitness level, goal, schedule, recent riding). Helps the coach tailor the answer.

planText.description: Optional — the rider's current training plan, pasted as text. Use this if the question is about a specific plan.

question.description: The rider's question. Can be about anything cycling-related.

name: ask_cycling_coach
title: Ask the Etapa cycling coach
